uz.title: Statistik da’volarni baholash: kuzatuv tadqiqotlari va tajribalar
uz.summary: Tadqiqot qanday o‘tkazilganiga qarab qaysi xulosa asosli ekanini aniqlash: natijani kimga umumlashtirish mumkin va sabab-oqibat haqida gapirish mumkinmi. Ikki kalit ibora — randomly selected va randomly assigned.

sections.heading: Bu ko‘nikma nimani tekshiradi
sections.body:
Bu ko‘nikmada hisob deyarli yo‘q: sizdan tadqiqot tavsifini o‘qib, undan **qaysi xulosa kelib chiqishini** aniqlash so‘raladi. Hammasi ikki savolga borib taqaladi:

- **Ishtirokchilar bosh to‘plamdan tasodifiy tanlanganmi (random selection)?** Ha bo‘lsa — natijani **shu bosh to‘plamga** umumlashtirish mumkin. Yo‘q bo‘lsa (ko‘ngillilar, qo‘l ostidagi qulay guruh) — faqat o‘rganilganlar haqida gapirish mumkin.
- **Ishtirokchilar guruhlarga tasodifiy taqsimlanganmi (random assignment)?** Ha bo‘lsa — bu **tajriba** (experiment) va **sabab-oqibat** (cause-and-effect) haqida xulosa qilish mumkin. Yo‘q bo‘lsa — bu **kuzatuv tadqiqoti** (observational study) va faqat **bog‘liqlik** (association) haqida gapirish mumkin.

Natijada to‘rt holat bo‘ladi:

- Tasodifiy tanlash + tasodifiy taqsimlash → sabab-oqibat, butun bosh to‘plam uchun.
- Faqat tasodifiy taqsimlash → sabab-oqibat, lekin faqat ishtirokchilar uchun.
- Faqat tasodifiy tanlash → bog‘liqlik, butun bosh to‘plam uchun.
- Hech biri yo‘q → faqat ishtirokchilar orasidagi bog‘liqlik.

Kuzatuv tadqiqotida sabab haqida gapirib bo‘lmasligining sababi — **chalkashtiruvchi omillar** (confounding variables). Masalan, ko‘p kitob o‘qiydigan o‘quvchilarning baholari yuqori bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin bunga uydagi qo‘llab-quvvatlash kabi boshqa omil ham sabab bo‘lishi mumkin.

sections.heading: Savolni qanday tanib olasiz
items: *“Which of the following conclusions is best supported by the study?”*, *“Which statement is an appropriate conclusion?”* — xulosani baholash savoli.
Tavsifda *“were selected at random from …”* yoki *“volunteered”*, *“chose to respond to an online poll”* — tanlash usuli: kimga umumlashtirish mumkinligini hal qiladi.
Tavsifda *“were randomly assigned to …”*, *“treatment group”*, *“control group”* — tajriba belgisi.
Tavsifda *“researchers surveyed …”*, *“recorded …”*, *“found that people who …”* — ishtirokchilar guruhni o‘zlari tanlagan yoki shunchaki kuzatilgan: bu kuzatuv tadqiqoti.
Variantlarda *“causes”*, *“leads to”*, *“improves”*, *“lowers”* yoki *“is associated with”*, *“is related to”* — sabab yoki bog‘liqlik da’vosi.

sections.heading: Ishlash usuli: qadamma-qadam
steps: **Ishtirokchilar qanday tanlanganini belgilang.** Tasodifiymi? Qaysi guruhdan (bitta universitet, bitta shahar, ko‘ngillilar)? Shu guruh — umumlashtirish chegarasi.
**Guruhlarga kim ajratganini belgilang.** Tadqiqotchi tasodifiy taqsimlagan bo‘lsa — tajriba. Odamlar o‘zlari tanlagan yoki shunchaki kuzatilgan bo‘lsa — kuzatuv tadqiqoti.
**Xulosaning kuchini aniqlang:** tajriba → “causes”, “is likely to improve” mumkin; kuzatuv → faqat “is associated with”.
**Xulosaning qamrovini aniqlang:** tasodifiy tanlangan bo‘lsa — o‘sha bosh to‘plam; aks holda — faqat ishtirokchilar.

**Har bir variantni kuch va qamrov bo‘yicha sinang.** Variant juda kuchli (sabab, “hamma”, “isbotlaydi”) ham, juda kuchsiz (“hech qanday xulosa qilib bo‘lmaydi”) ham bo‘lishi mumkin — to‘g‘ri javob aynan ma’lumot ruxsat bergan darajada bo‘ladi.

sections.heading: Namuna 1: tasodifiy tanlash va tasodifiy taqsimlash

example.problem: A researcher selected 300 students at random from a large university. The researcher randomly assigned 150 of the students to use a vocabulary flashcard app for 20 minutes each day and the other 150 students not to use the app. After 6 weeks, the students who used the app had a significantly higher mean score on a vocabulary test than the students who did not. Which of the following conclusions is best supported by the study?
choices: Using the app causes higher vocabulary test scores for students at any university.
Using the app is likely to improve vocabulary test scores for students at this university.
Using the app is associated with higher vocabulary test scores, but no cause-and-effect conclusion can be drawn.
Using the app will improve the vocabulary test score of every student at this university.
solution: Tanlash: 300 talaba **shu universitetdan tasodifiy** tanlangan → natijani shu universitet talabalariga umumlashtirish mumkin.
Taqsimlash: tadqiqotchi talabalarni ilovadan foydalanadigan va foydalanmaydigan guruhlarga **tasodifiy** ajratgan → bu tajriba, sabab-oqibat haqida gapirish mumkin.
Demak to‘g‘ri xulosa: ilova **shu universitet** talabalarining natijasini yaxshilashi ehtimoli katta — B variant.
Nega A xato: qamrov juda keng — boshqa universitetlar talabalari tanlanmada bo‘lmagan.
Nega C xato: juda kuchsiz — tasodifiy taqsimlash bo‘lgani uchun sabab-oqibat xulosasi qilish mumkin.
Nega D xato: *“every student”* — statistik natija o‘rtacha haqida, har bir talaba uchun kafolat bermaydi.

example.problem: Researchers surveyed a random sample of 1,000 adults in a country. They found that adults who reported drinking at least 3 cups of tea per day had, on average, lower blood pressure than adults who reported drinking fewer than 3 cups of tea per day. Which of the following conclusions is best supported by the study?
choices: Drinking at least 3 cups of tea per day lowers blood pressure for adults in the country.
For adults in the country, drinking at least 3 cups of tea per day is associated with lower blood pressure.
Drinking at least 3 cups of tea per day lowers blood pressure for people in every country.
No conclusion can be drawn about adults in the country, because the participants were not randomly assigned to drink tea.
solution: Tanlash: mamlakat kattalaridan **tasodifiy** tanlanma → natijani shu mamlakat kattalariga umumlashtirish mumkin.
Taqsimlash: kim qancha choy ichishini odamlar **o‘zlari** tanlagan, tadqiqotchilar faqat so‘rashgan → kuzatuv tadqiqoti, faqat bog‘liqlik haqida gapirish mumkin.
Demak: mamlakat kattalari orasida ko‘p choy ichish past qon bosimi bilan **bog‘liq** — B variant.
Nega A xato: *“lowers”* — sabab da’vosi. Ko‘p choy ichadiganlar, masalan, kamroq kofe ichishi yoki ko‘proq harakat qilishi mumkin — qon bosimiga aynan shu omil ta’sir qilayotgan bo‘lishi mumkin.
Nega C xato: ham sabab da’vosi, ham qamrov juda keng (boshqa mamlakatlar tanlanmada bo‘lmagan).
Nega D xato: juda kuchsiz. Tasodifiy taqsimlash bo‘lmagani uchun sabab haqida gapirib bo‘lmaydi, lekin tasodifiy **tanlash** bo‘lgani uchun bog‘liqlikni butun bosh to‘plamga umumlashtirish mumkin.

example.problem: A city council wanted to know how city residents feel about a proposed bike lane. The council posted a poll on its social media page, and 2,400 people chose to respond. Of those who responded, 71% said they oppose the bike lane. Which of the following statements is most appropriate?
choices: About 71% of the city's residents oppose the bike lane.
The results may not represent the opinions of all city residents, because the people who responded chose to participate.
The results represent all city residents, because the sample size of 2,400 is large.
The poll shows that the proposed bike lane caused most residents to be unhappy.
solution: Tanlash: odamlar javob berishni o‘zlari tanlagan (*“chose to respond”*) — bu **ixtiyoriy javob** (voluntary response) tanlanmasi, tasodifiy emas.

Bunday so‘rovnomaga odatda masala bo‘yicha kuchli fikri bor odamlar ko‘proq javob beradi; bundan tashqari, faqat kengashning sahifasini kuzatuvchilar qatnashgan. Natija noxolis (biased) bo‘lishi mumkin — B variant.
Nega A xato: tasodifiy bo‘lmagan tanlanmadan butun shahar haqida foiz chiqarib bo‘lmaydi.
Nega C xato: katta hajm tanlov usulidagi kamchilikni tuzatmaydi — 2400 ta ixtiyoriy javob ham noxolis bo‘lishi mumkin.
Nega D xato: so‘rovnoma sabab-oqibatni tekshirmaydi; qolaversa, yo‘lak hali qurilmagan (*“proposed”*), u hech narsaga sabab bo‘la olmaydi.

sections.heading: Nimaga e’tibor berish kerak
items: **“Randomly selected” va “randomly assigned” — har xil narsa.** Birinchisi kimga umumlashtirishni, ikkinchisi sabab haqida gapirish mumkinligini hal qiladi. Matnda ikkalasini alohida qidiring.
**Katta tanlanma — hali yaxshi tanlanma degani emas.** Tanlov usuli noxolis bo‘lsa, hajm buni tuzatmaydi.
**Qamrov — tanlanma olingan joy:** bitta maktab, bitta shahar, bitta yosh guruhi… Xulosa undan kengaymasligi kerak.
**Nazorat guruhi (control group)** bo‘lmasa, o‘zgarishni aynan muolajaga bog‘lash qiyin.
**Chalkashtiruvchi omil:** kuzatuv tadqiqotida guruhlar boshqa jihatlardan ham farq qilishi mumkin — shuning uchun sabab da’vosi asossiz.
**Juda kuchsiz variant ham xato bo‘ladi:** tadqiqot tasodifiy taqsimlangan tajriba bo‘lsa, “sabab haqida hech narsa deyib bo‘lmaydi” degan variant noto‘g‘ri.

sections.heading: Keng tarqalgan xatolar (tuzoq variantlar)
items: **Kuzatuvdan sabab xulosasi:** kuzatuv tadqiqotiga oid variantda *“lowers”*, *“causes”*, *“improves”* so‘zlari — tuzoq (namuna 2, A).
**Ortiqcha umumlashtirish:** “any university”, “every country”, “all teenagers” (namuna 1, A; namuna 2, C).
**Har bir shaxs uchun kafolat:** *“every student will improve”* (namuna 1, D).
**Hajm bilan oqlash:** “sample is large, so it represents everyone” (namuna 3, C).
**Haddan tashqari ehtiyotkorlik:** tajribada “no cause-and-effect conclusion” yoki tasodifiy tanlanmada “no conclusion about the population” (namuna 1, C; namuna 2, D).

sections.heading: Vaqt bo‘yicha maslahat
items: Bu tur odatda tez yechiladi: **30–60 soniya**. Hisob yo‘q, asosiy ish — tavsifni diqqat bilan o‘qish.
Variantlarni o‘qishdan oldin qoralamaga ikki belgi qo‘ying: “tanlash: random / random emas (kimdan?)” va “taqsimlash: random / yo‘q”. Keyin variantlar yuqoridagi to‘rt holat bo‘yicha tez saralanadi.
Desmos va kalkulyator bu turda kerak emas — tejalgan vaqtni hisob talab qiladigan savollarga qoldiring.
Bu ko‘nikma savollarida javob gap ko‘rinishida bo‘lgani uchun ular odatda variantli (multiple-choice) bo‘ladi; shu sababli bu qo‘llanmadagi barcha namunalar variantli.

terms.meaning: kuzatuv tadqiqoti: tadqiqotchi faqat kuzatadi, guruhlarga o‘zi ajratmaydi
tajriba: kim qaysi muolajani olishini tadqiqotchi belgilaydi
guruhlarga tasodifiy taqsimlangan → sabab-oqibat haqida gapirish mumkin
tasodifiy tanlangan → bosh to‘plamga umumlashtirish mumkin
bog‘liq — lekin biri ikkinchisiga sabab bo‘lishi shart emas
umumlashtirish: natijani kengroq guruhga tatbiq etish
ko‘ngilli / ixtiyoriy javob — noxolis tanlanma belgisi
noxolislik: natijaning bir tomonga tizimli og‘ishi

sections.heading: Javobni tanlashdan oldin tekshiring
items: Ishtirokchilar tasodifiy tanlanganmi — va qaysi guruhdan?
Guruhlarga tasodifiy taqsimlanganmi (tajribami yoki kuzatuvmi)?
Tanlagan variantim ma’lumot ruxsat bergandan kuchliroq ham, kuchsizroq ham emasmi?
